parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by recursively cleansing list and tuple settings, but it may not handle all iterable types.

issues.description: The patch only handles lists and tuples, but other iterable types like sets or custom iterables are not addressed. This may lead to insufficient cleansing in some cases.
